label: Cerebras
engine: OpenClaw agent harness (Gateway /v1/chat/completions, one agent turn)

definitions.tps_generation: completion tokens / time from first streamed token to end of response, summed over all calls
definitions.tps_end_to_end: completion tokens / full request duration including time to first token
definitions.agent_loop_ms: first model request to agent sign-off: model time + tool time. This is the headline elapsed time
definitions.wall_ms: run start to agent sign-off; includes harness setup and tool time, excludes gateway warm-up and the KiCad oracle
definitions.harness_setup_ms: run start to the first model request (session, MCP server and prompt assembly inside the agent harness)
